name: Ersveil: Bluewatch Starter
author: Story Suite examples
description: Test-play pack for Story Suite v2 in the Ersveil world: Wessel arrives at Bluewatch Village, the northernmost village, with three F-letter jobs on the Guild board. Money is the lore's three coins, copper, silver and gold (1 gold = 10 silver = 100 copper), counted in copper. Lore stays in the Ersveil lorebooks.

economy.note: copper is small coin: about 8 copper to one coin of the built-in defaults

items.name: Cane-Blade
items.note: Self-made katana-shaped blade hidden in an ash walking stick with an iron ferrule; crude steel, dulls fast, may snap on mail; heavier than any stick.

items.name: Patched Oilcloth Coat
items.note: River-worn and patched.

items.name: Minor Healing Draught
items.note: Closes wounds, leaves weakness and a scar.

items.name: Leech-salt Pouch
items.note: Coarse salt in burlap, thrown or packed: leeches let go and shrivel.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.note: One day.

items.name: Lamp Oil
items.note: Enough for one night.

items.name: Backpack
items.note: Frame pack of oiled canvas: carries 20 more while someone has it.

items.name: Pack Mule
items.note: A sure-footed river-road mule with its harness: carries 80 more for whoever leads it.

items.name: Barge Hold Share
items.note: A paid share of a river barge's hold for the party's goods: 200 more carried while the party keeps it.

items.name: Coarse Salt
items.note: A scoop from the salt sheds.

items.name: Completion Salts
items.note: Licensed salt-and-iron mix that seals one body.

items.name: Fur-lined Cloak
items.note: Bluewatch cold-weather gear.

items.name: Live Leech
items.note: Alchemists and barber-surgeons buy them.

items.name: Small Monster Core
items.note: Intact core of a Soul Class I creature.

items.name: Bluecap Moss
items.note: Pale moss off the culvert stones; alchemists steep it for salves and draughts.

items.name: Cleansing Spirits
items.note: A stoppered flask of strong clear spirit for wounds and glassware.

items.name: Iron Filings
items.note: A twist of forge filings: the iron in salt-and-iron mixes.

events.cue: The Guild office beside the Watchhouse opens its shutters. Fenna, the branch clerk, pins three F-letter notices to the board: Granary Rats (6 cellar rats, 5 silver), East Bluff Wolves (4 starved crag wolves, 2 gold) and Culvert Leeches (8 sluice leeches off the north culvert grate by Goldwane 14 dusk, 1 gold 2 silver).

events.when: time() != null && time() >= 316932180 && !(quest('East Bluff Wolves') != null && quest('East Bluff Wolves').ended != null && quest('East Bluff Wolves').ended.outcome == 'done')
events.cue: At dusk the crag wolves howl from the east bluff, close enough that the tower watch counts them aloud: four, maybe five, and one deeper voice.

events.when: time() != null && time() >= 316933560 && !(quest('Culvert Leeches') != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended.outcome == 'done')
events.cue: Rain in the northern hills: the north culvert runs brown and high, its grate thick with leeches. The sluice keeper says it will back up by tomorrow dusk.

events.when: time() != null && time() >= 316935060 && !(quest('Culvert Leeches') != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended.outcome == 'done')
events.cue: The clogged north culvert backs up. Muddy water floods the storehouse lane and the lowest granary cellar; the Watch blames the Guild office for a job left on the board.

events.when: (quest('Culvert Leeches') != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended != null && quest('Culvert Leeches').ended.outcome == 'done') && time() != null && time() < 316935060
events.cue: A runner from the Watchhouse: the north culvert ran clear through the hill rain. Watch-Captain Rorke sends 2 silver on top of the Guild's fee.

payload.note: Watch-Captain Rorke's thanks for the culvert

events.when: (quest('Granary Rats') != null && quest('Granary Rats').ended != null && quest('Granary Rats').ended.outcome == 'done')
events.cue: Word goes round the storehouses that the granary cellars are quiet; the quartermaster nods at the newcomer for the first time.

races.name: Human
races.note: The most numerous people, masters of the Northern Belt and the rivers. Short, hard lives. No stat change, so a kit's stats come out as written.

races.name: Elf
races.note: Three to five centuries of life and a long memory for what humans did. Tolerated, resented, still sold in slave markets.

races.name: Dwarf
races.note: Hold-born, oath-bound, about two centuries of life. "Stone remembers."

races.name: Halfling
races.note: River-town folk of barges, kitchens and ledgers; quietly indispensable to Confederacy trade.

races.name: Beastfolk
races.note: Animal ears, tails or horns and keen senses; refused rooms and suspected first, valued as scouts.

races.name: Orc
races.note: Large, strong, short-lived; vilified as half-monsters, with bounties in some Highmark provinces.

races.name: Goblin
races.note: Small, quick, short-lived fixers and couriers nobody notices until too late; most realms treat them as vermin.

talents.name: Shadow-bent
talents.note: An outward bent toward shadow, woken late and self-taught, with no spell grammar.

talents.name: River-born
talents.note: Born on the Confederacy waterways: Riverspeech first, at home on a barge deck and in cold water.

talents.name: Hulkrow-raised
talents.note: Grew up in the floating slum of Thousand Sails: reads a crowd, finds the back way out.

talents.name: Hidden Draw
talents.note: A self-taught draw-cut from a hidden sheath: the first blow lands before the fight starts.

talents.name: Inward Bent
talents.note: The common bent: mana pushed into the body for strength and toughness.

talents.name: Frontier Tracker
talents.note: Knows wolf sign, wet ground and which way the herds will run.

skills.name: Cane Draw
skills.note: The hidden blade drawn and cut in one motion.

skills.name: Shadow Cut
skills.note: The draw-cut carried past the blade as a thin arc of cold shadow, cutting every foe within a pace or two.

presets.name: Wessel (kit)
presets.note: STR 5, VIT 6, AGI 8, DEX 8, INT 7, LUK 6, CHA 5 with Human and the two talents (2 points) plus these 8. Name and background come from the persona.

places.name: Auvoth Depths
places.note: Treaty-controlled megadungeon under Auvoth: sealed internal descents, F to SSS by depth.

places.name: Rimeglass Delve
places.note: Seasonal licensed delve (C-B): cold iron, blue coal, ice crystals; moving ice galleries.

places.name: Inspection Quay
places.note: Stone river-gate with its chain across the Bluewatch Branch; every hand is named here before stepping ashore.

places.name: Watchhouse
places.note: Seat of Watch-Captain Rorke; the signal tower trails brazier smoke and faces north.

places.name: Stray Oar
places.note: Inn for convoy crews; the salvage convoy to Auvoth hires guards here.

places.name: Guild Office
places.note: A one-room Adventurer Guild branch desk beside the Watchhouse; Fenna keeps the register and the job board.

places.name: Watch Granary
places.note: The Watch storehouses and the granary cellars under them.

places.name: Salt-and-Ash Yard
places.note: Where the lay sealer completes the dead, since no priest lives this far north; the salt sheds stand by it.

places.name: Gate Forge
places.note: The Watch smith's forge by the river-gate.

places.name: North Culvert
places.note: Stone culvert under the north road that drains the hill stream past the palisade; a grate keeps debris out.

places.name: East Bluff
places.note: Rocky bluff above the river east of the palisade; crag wolves den in its clefts.

routes.note: code W Does not pass through Shornmarch. Northbound is upstream.
code W Northbound is upstream. Frostgate's lock is the head of navigation; beyond it, sledge or road to Shorn. Ices over in deep winter; sledges then run the Bastion Road.
code W Northbound is upstream. Frostgate's lock is the head of navigation; beyond it, sledge or road to Shorn. Ices over in deep winter; sledges then run the Bastion Road.
sealed internal descents, about 3 km; registered parties only

markets.note: Lock towns on the river: toll-keepers' markets, a little dear.
Goods pay the lock toll; salt barges unload here.

crafts.title: Alchemy
crafts.note: A craft, not spellcasting: clean reagents, glassware, heat and time. A slip poisons or burns the alchemist.

crafts.title: Fieldcraft
crafts.note: Frontier makeshift work, done anywhere: salt pouches, pitch torches, snares.

meters.name: Regard
meters.describe: How far a frontier local trusts an outsider. Strangers start below even.

meters.name: Owed
meters.describe: Favours this person owes you. Nothing on the frontier is free, and debts are remembered for a while.

stages.name: Marked as trouble
stages.milestone: They name you to the Watch as trouble.

stages.name: Vouched for
stages.milestone: They will speak for you at the Watchhouse or the Guild desk.

meters.name: Loyalty
meters.describe: Whether they stay when staying costs them.

meters.name: Nerve
meters.describe: How steady they are after blood and bad nights. Rest brings it back.

stages.name: Wavering
stages.milestone: They start counting what staying costs them.

stages.name: Shield-mate
stages.milestone: They would hold the line beside you.

classes.name: Barge Drifter
classes.note: Barge-born laborers and debt-runners surviving on sharp wits, quick steps, and improvised weapons along the waterways.

classes.name: Slum Stalker
classes.note: Hulkrow street survivors adept at concealing weapons, exploiting blind spots, and slipping past city watchmen.

classes.name: Shadow Blade
classes.note: Practitioners whose inward reinforcement awakens an outward shadow gift, shrouding blades in cold darkness.

classes.name: Veil Walker
classes.note: Masters of the liminal shadow who step through umbral rifts to deliver devastating draw-cuts from nothingness.

classes.name: Militiaman
classes.note: Town levies and watchmen trained to form crude spear walls and hold against frontier beast incursions.

classes.name: Iron Cadet
classes.note: Recruits of the Iron Guard Fortress drilled in foundational reinforcement breathing and formation discipline.

classes.name: Wall Warden
classes.note: Hardened veterans anchoring shield lines during siege breaches, turning their reinforced bodies into stone.

classes.name: Last Wall Sentinel
classes.note: Living bulwarks carrying the oath of the Last Wall, impervious to siege blows and shatter waves.

classes.name: Blade Initiate
classes.note: Aspirants practicing footwork and edge alignment in alley rings and duelling courtyards across the river cities.

classes.name: Mirage Fencer
classes.note: Students of Mirage City's rival fencing houses, trading lethal thrusts and fast single-sword feints.

classes.name: Sword Dancer
classes.note: Acrobatic duelists blending reinforcement breathing into fluid multi-directional sword forms and parries.

classes.name: Blade Master
classes.note: Apex practitioners of Otherworlder iaijutsu, cleaving steel and wind in a single unanswerable instant.

classes.name: Flame Initiate
classes.note: Church novices keeping vigil with consecrated oil lamps, learning initial completion prayers for the departed.

classes.name: Cinder Acolyte
classes.note: Ordained attendants skilled in ritual flamecraft to ward burial grounds and speed the soul's release.

classes.name: Flame Inquisitor
classes.note: Inquest enforcers purging corruption, rot, and the risen dead with unforgiving consecrated fire.

classes.name: Purifier
classes.note: Holy champions whose living flame incinerates blasphemous monstrosities while shielding the faithful.

classes.name: Hedge Apprentice
classes.note: Scrap-scroll scholars and hedge dabblers awakening outward mana into simple projected force and elemental sparks.

classes.name: Spell Weaver
classes.note: Scholars grasping formal spell grammar, weaving stable force barriers and crystallized ice bolts.

classes.name: Elementalist
classes.note: Journeymen of Startrace Tower commanding raw elemental currents to strike targets with lightning and frost.

classes.name: Astral Sage
classes.note: Masters of celestial grammar capable of summoning astral firestorms and impenetrable mana spheres.
